text:
I'm sorry about your plant. Unfortunately, repotting into non-Leafy soil in the first 14 days isn't covered by the Plant Care Guarantee, so a replacement under the guarantee isn't available for this case, since you repotted on day 5.

Two other options may help:
- A Plant Care Specialist can give you free care advice by chat or email, which may help you try to save the plant.
- If you think something else caused the problem, such as the plant arriving damaged, the DOA route only applies if you report within 48 hours of delivery, so that wouldn't apply here.

If you'd like a second look at your situation, I can escalate it to a Support Lead.
